reviews.x: Received this product a yesterday and tried it out this morning. I wanted to write to let you know how amazing and easy this brow kit is to use. The kit has 3 shapes for the brows for you to choose from with tweezers and microrazor and color pen that allows you to color in your brow in hair like texture. This is the best one yet and I have tried lots of brow pencils.

I didn’t have high hopes for this product because my brows are thin, sparse, gray. However, I ordered the dark gray and I have brows again. It works wonderfully and the strokes of the brush look so natural. Will definitely order again.

I bought this pen because I tried a different one & I loved the concept & it worked ok, but I wanted to find "The One" ...Found it !!! This works so good. When I do my makeup I'll take a before & after photo. I was worried about the color . I have dark brown /soft black brows & they were out of or don't have black. All they had was Gray. I took a chance after seeing pictures. Im impressed & so far I love this pen. Totally worth trying. It may not be for every one, but I love it. The extras that

I kept seeing the new brow pens on the market but they seem pricey.  My eyebrows are thin and sparse and this has been an easy fix. The color was perfect! Long lasting without a doubt, I'm currently working in a space without air circulation so the sweat just pours off in this summer heat, but my eyebrows stay on all day! In a world of wearing masks, you don't bother putting on a full face of makeup but my brows look good everyday and that's important since that's all you see when you're wearing
Fantastic results, but it doesn't last as long as one would hope--best is three weeks' max
This pen is one of my favorites so far. It glides on and the color is rich and natural looking. It’s easy and the color is great!
Make your eyebrows look nice especially for those with light eyebrows and  it stays on for a long time. NO microblading needed.

What was supposed to be dark gray turned out to be purple. The requirement of "using a light hand" is an understatement.  It was enough to make my husband laugh at my eyebrows.  I washed it off quickly!  Fortunately, it had not "frozen" in place.  Do not buy this produce.

reviews.t: Perfect with my new “natural” color hair and so easy to apply!
reviews.x: This is EXACTLY what I needed since letting my hair grow out to my “natural” color....my eyebrows needed just a bit of definition and color to accent the new natural white of my hair. I got the dark grey and it’s the perfect color to fill in my salt & pepper brows. The applicator with the brow like tip helps the color go on with just the right amount of color. Not too dark. Very easy to apply, and it enhances my new natural color with beautifully defined brows. My favorite purchase in months!

Ok so this is actually not bad but the tips that were supposed to do the streaks have already dried out, not sure if I used it wrong but I just can’t get the same results anymore and I can definitely see some product in there ... I would still recommend it for the price ...

reviews.t: Easy on, long-lasting dark Grey eyebrow marker
reviews.x: I really like the color of this product. It is perfect with my salt and pepper hair. The ease of use makes it my go to when I need eyebrows fast! And it stays on all day!

reviews.t: What they promote is what you get!
reviews.x: WOW!!!!! Very impressive package and product. By far best thing I ever got from amazon! I fail getting good brow products but this one is one of a kind!
Very natural looking! Long lasting this is the next morning after applying and forgetting to clean off

reviews.t: Saved the thin spots on my brows
reviews.x: I didn’t realize the eyebrow pen came with tweezers, stencils and a razor. After an over tweezing incident a few weeks ago, I got a little impatient with the brows growing back. I ordered this pen and it helped fill in a few thin spots. I suggest letting it set awhile before touching it. I made a few spots too dark and it wiped off easily with a damp Qtip. After a day of wear at work it was removed quickly with a makeup wipe. I’ve had other gels, pencils and even stains and they didn’t do as wel

reviews.t: Works great after the first week or two
reviews.x: I've used this eyebrow pen every day for the past 12 days and really like it. When I first started using it, though, the ink came out so heavily that my eyebrows looked really dark and fake, and I couldn't get it to look natural no matter how lightly I pressed it. After almost 2 weeks, the ink is coming out more and more naturally and I now have more control over how dark I want my eyebrows to be. So if you want more pronounced eyebrows, you can achieve that look with this pen, and if you want d

I was skeptical of this product actually performing as advertised.  After trying many brow products before, I always felt as if they left my eyebrows looking too artificial and drawn on.  My brows are mostly dark, so I never had an issue until I got older.  My brows were wearing off at the sides (I'm a side sleeper) and some over plucked areas stopped growing back.  This product is so easy to use!  I can make them look more complete as a day look or more dramatic brows for evenings out.  The eye

reviews.t: One of the best things on the planet for my eyebrows
reviews.x: My eyebrows had been fading for a while. As with age, your body changes. I was really starting to feel ashamed of my eyebrows. I had used pencils and other products to try to fill them in. It worked for a while but was just extremely tedious and time-consuming. With this product, I have solved that problem, my eyebrows look full and stay on well. This is truly one of the best products I have tried to help my fading eyebrows its quick and lasts a long time. I highly recommend this product to anyo

reviews.t: Natural looking, easy to use and worth it!!
reviews.x: Great product! Couple extra minutes getting ready helps me walk out of the house feeling extra on point! Slight learning curve imho, but once you learn how to apply (lighter strokes and perfecting the angle), you’ll have excellent results! Looks clean and natural! Has become part of my daily routine. Stays all day. Great price too, and I had amazing customer service when I contacted them. Only has dark grey available which worker with my very dark brown hair and tan skin.

reviews.t: Dark brown hair order Dark Grey
reviews.x: This eyebrow pen is super cute. Comes with plenty of goodies to help you get the perfect brow. You will hav to play with the amount of pressure you put on the pen to get the correct shading but these two minute quick brows came out pretty decent. I ordered the chestnut brown but it was too light so I sent it back and got the dark grey. I think it blends well with my natural brow. Also, it did last two days. Not smudge proof but did last on my oily skin.

Very happy with this eyebrow pen! When I first got it, I decided to put it it on and keep it overnight to check how well it would stay put. Next day, it was still in tact and no smudges! Was super pleased so now I can stop worrying about accidentally messing up my eyebrows. I have also run my hand through it (after letting it dry, which is fast) and it did not smudge. Like that it’s easy to use. It can make fine lines and fill in easily.

This is pretty great. I went with the gray and it was close to perfect match to my brows. They are dark but not black. It had just a tad of warmth to the color. I will definitely buy again. The strokes take a bit of practice to make it look natural so keep that in mind. Stays put all day and sweat proof.

This goes on very easy and dries very fast, so you have like no time to fix a boo boo. I had to use some pressure in order to get it off. The color is true to the picture. This is more of a "marker" then any other kind of eyebrow "pen". Over all this is a good product and the price is worth it!

reviews.t: Lasts! I am going to use this one from now on!
reviews.x: I have tried a few of these pens, and most rub off right away. I received this one, and put a clear mark on the back of my hand. When I woke up the next morning, it was still there, clear and crisp. I love this. Thank you! And the little stencils and eyebrow shaper are a nice bonus too!

This eyebrow pen is great!! It dries instantly and will not come off without makeup remover. The grey brown color is really hard to find, most eyebrow products have a reddish tint that clashes with my skin tone. It’s a decent price too, I’ll probably stick with this one from now on!

This eyebrow pen is just a waste of money.  It does not work well at all!  The color barely comes out of the pen and does not dispense more even if you need more to add to your brows.... I would never buy this product again...Cheap and waste of good money.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pen for creating natural-looking brows, especially for thin or sparse eyebrows.
Many reviewers highlight that the product is easy to apply and long-lasting, staying on all day or through sweat.
Several reviewers say the dark gray color works perfectly for salt-and-pepper or natural hair.
A few reviewers report issues with color accuracy or application, such as dark gray appearing purple or ink coming out too heavily at first.
Some reviewers mention durability concerns, including tips drying out or the product not lasting as long as hoped.
